# Seconds per cmd/monoagentcli top-level test (subtests included), used by monoagentcli-shard.sh
# to balance the four monoagentcli test shards. Measured 2026-11-03 with
# `go test ./cmd/monoagentcli -race -json` on a 24-core box under nokc.sh; the 28 tests that had
# not finished when that run hit its own 120m limit carry 26 x their non-race time (the median
# race/non-race ratio). Only the relative sizes matter. A test missing from this file weighs the
# median of the file. Refresh occasionally: nothing breaks if it goes stale, the split just drifts.
